title: The dark side of AI generated influencers

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this hyper-realistic AI influencer — she’s not human, but she’s selling millions of dollars in products.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This trend is exploding — over 500 AI influencers are now active on social media.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re generated using deepfake tech that mimics real people’s expressions and voices.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: One company even created an AI clone of a famous model — without her permission.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Brand deals and followers are pouring in, but the real people are getting left out.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key issue? These AI influencers can’t be held accountable for false claims.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you ever seen an AI influencer — and what did you think?
